matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR converges roughly ten times faster than the original DETR while achieving better detection performance, particularly on small objects.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR has relatively low performance in detecting small objects compared to modern detectors using high-resolution feature maps.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR replaces dense attention with deformable attention modules that attend to a small set of sampling points per query, reducing computational complexity.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The deformable attention module attends to only a small set of key sampling points around a reference point.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Multi-scale deformable attention naturally handles small objects efficiently without resorting to a separately constructed multi-scale feature pyramid head.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The multi-scale deformable attention module can naturally aggregate multi-scale feature maps without feature pyramid networks.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Standard global self-attention used in DETR results in slow convergence and quadratic memory cost when applied to multi-scale features.
